verdicts_or_reports.element: Reminders may be delayed information row
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The Settings row should remain reachable above the bottom navigation and should open its reminder delay information when tapped.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The row is partly covered by the bottom navigation. Tapping it navigates to Journal instead of opening the reminder information.
steps: Open Settings in portrait and rotate the device to landscape.
Scroll until the Notifications section and the “Reminders may be delayed.” row are at the bottom.
Tap the “Reminders may be delayed.” row.

verdicts_or_reports.field: Landscape Settings list / bottom navigation overlap
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Tapping this row should open the same “Allow exact alarms?” dialog it opens in portrait.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: In landscape, the row is behind the bottom navigation. Tapping its center opens Journal instead of the exact alarms dialog.
steps: In portrait, open Settings and tap “Reminders may be delayed.”; confirm the “Allow exact alarms?” dialog appears, then tap Skip.
Rotate to landscape while still on Settings.
Tap the center of the visible “Reminders may be delayed.” row near the bottom of the screen.
Observe that Journal opens instead of the exact alarms dialog.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Second scheduled medication card for Triptorelin
verdicts_or_reports.field: Scheduled medication card / bottom navigation overlap
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Both scheduled medication cards should remain fully visible and tappable above the bottom navigation after rotation.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The bottom navigation overlays the second medication card, covering part of its name and secondary caption. Swiping the list upward does not move the card clear of the navigation.
steps: In portrait, create a medication group with two medicines so both scheduled medication cards appear on Plan.
Open Plan and rotate the device to landscape.
Observe the second card at the bottom of the screen and try to swipe the list upward.

verdicts_or_reports.field: Card tap target overlaps bottom navigation
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Tapping the Triptorelin card should open its Add record sheet, as it does in portrait.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The card center overlaps the bottom navigation; tapping it opens Journal.
steps: From a fresh install, add QA Estradiol as an Estradiol tablet with strength 2 mg.
Add Triptorelin as a GnRHa injection with strength 3.75 mg.
Create a group containing both medicines and save it.
On Plan in portrait, tap the Triptorelin scheduled card once to verify it opens Add record, then cancel.
Tap the center of the Triptorelin card (about x=1200, y=951 on the 2400×1080 landscape screen).
Observe that Journal opens instead of Add record.
